arguments.name: kubeconfig
arguments.description: Existing kubeconfig file with an authenticated OpenShift context, passed to oc through KUBECONFIG.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: OpenShift namespace whose resources are synchronized.

arguments.name: yaml_repository
arguments.description: YAML repository directory the resources are written into (created when missing).

arguments.name: ignore_resources
arguments.description: Resource names or data keys to leave out, keyed by configmaps or secrets with 'names' and 'keys' lists; merged with the built-in defaults.

outputs.name: repository
outputs.description: YAML repository path that was synchronized.

outputs.name: resources
outputs.description: Repository-relative YAML files written, grouped by resource type (deployments, configmaps, secrets, services, routes).
